Your holdings: SOXL (-37.82%) and SPAL (-22.17%) are the clear pain points needing attention. They are leveraged ETFs and are bleeding, amplified by your margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMCI (-4.61%) and MU (-9.30%) as they are also in the red and part of your concentrated tech book.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting your capital.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL to reduce margin risk, especially given their current PnL.
If SMCI or MU continue to drop, evaluate tightening their stops to lock in gains or limit further losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
